authorization_if_pass: The exact B9 transport committed on main may be used to send the 40 frozen B8 slot URLs to eligible voters only after url_distribution_preconditions P1-P6 are satisfied and recorded. No outcome analysis or production V9 activation is authorized.
purpose: Deploy the B8-authorized V9 voter transport plus the narrow reserved-row isolation required to keep V9 submissions out of normal KTC ratings, after exact frozen-artifact, serialization, leakage, and production-firewall parity checks.

session_transport.uncertain_submission_policy: fail closed; mark session aborted and require replacement voter on identical slot URL; never retry an uncertain challenge in the same session

transport_scope.normal_ktc_v9_reserved_row_exclusion: __pkgv9val__| added only to pre-existing PACKAGE_VOTE_PREFIXES before daily-cap and Bradley-Terry work
transport_scope.v8_and_normal_ktc_behavior_without_pkgv9: unchanged except V9 reserved rows are now excluded from KTC rating inputs as B8 requires

url_distribution_preconditions: P1 live page: GitHub Pages serves the patched index.html (transport block present; ?pkgv9slot=1 loads and hash-verifies the B8 artifacts in a real browser).

P2 collector acceptance: exactly one synthetic invalid-by-design row (keep __pkgv9val__|pkgv9val_LAUNCHTEST|A|L|<test-session>|<utc>, meta slot 0, envelope __pkgv9val_session__|0|<test-session>) is POSTed with the exact live envelope and confirmed stored with all fields intact. Slot 0 makes the row invalid under frozen B8 row validity, so it is excluded outcome-blind.

P3 KTC isolation live check: the next normal KTC pipeline run excludes the synthetic row before daily cap; the destination/use of package_transport_rows is confirmed not to publish or mis-parse V9 rows.

P4 no outcome exposure: V9 rows are not readable in any publicly published sheet/CSV or committed repo file during collection; if the collector sheet is published, V9 rows are routed to an unpublished destination before any voter URL is sent.
P5 outcome-blind monitoring: completion monitoring reports only per-slot session counts, completeness and validity, never choices.
P6 record: a launch-checklist file recording P1-P5 results is committed on main before the first voter URL is sent.
